paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bekhorot 50a, but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be “son of Rava,” as explained in the entry Rav Acha bar Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Bekhorot 50a paragraph names Rav Acha son of Ravina as the recipient of Rav Ashi’s money. Hyman’s bar Ravina heading, his scribal-error judgment, and his ‘should read son of Rava’ remain distinct from that digital reading. The cross-reference is retained as a pointer, without a fatherhood correction or authority merge.
